title: Normalize fictional events from JSON Lines
body: Implement exactly two Python 3 standard-library files, normalizer.py and cli.py, in the root of the disposable repository. In normalizer.py implement normalize_event(value). Accept a JSON object only if both id and kind are strings. Strip ASCII spaces, tabs, carriage returns and newlines from both ends of both strings. If either is empty after trimming, or the input is invalid, return None. Otherwise return a dict with exactly id (preserve case) and kind (lowercase ASCII); ignore extra fields. Input strings in this task consist of printable ASCII plus the listed whitespace. In cli.py import and actually call normalizer.normalize_event (direct function import also accepted). Read UTF-8 JSON Lines from standard input. Skip blank, malformed and invalid records. Emit one valid JSON object per accepted input on its own line in input order; preserve duplicates. Produce no other stdout and no stderr; exit zero for the specified inputs, including empty input and a final line without a newline. JSON key order and insignificant whitespace are immaterial. Example input {"id":" Z9 ","kind":" Open ","n":4} produces {"id":"Z9","kind":"open"}. Do not access files other than imports of the approved modules, the network, environment or subprocesses. Supply only the two full-file patch changes through the registered schema.
